name: smwmusic-shin-megami-tensei-ii-boss-battle-x2-style
title: Shin Megami Tensei II - Boss Battle (X2 Style)
description:
The Boss Battle theme from Shin Megami Tensei II, but I've been making multiple Megaman X style covers of this series already so saying the same thing is pretty boring and I won't waste your and my time this time I guess

Good for bosses, chase themes, and maybe fire/athletic/some other kind of intense level thing, though I'm legit curious on whether or not this would even work for levels tbh, since this definitely feels like it would be restricted to the first two scenarios I described above, but hey, maybe you can prove me wrong, I dunno lol
